title: Tool Reasoning Trace
description: Observable reasoning trace around a single tool call. Records what the model chose, what it received, and what followed — without capturing hidden chain-of-thought.

user_goal_summary.description: Short summary of the user goal at this step, if available.

active_plan_summary.description: Summary of the active plan or sub-task, if available.

tool_selection_rationale_summary.description: Brief model-visible rationale for choosing this tool. Empty if not exposed.

normalized_input_sha256.description: SHA256 of the canonical input JSON to the tool.

input_summary.description: Short human-readable summary of input (e.g. 'path=src/main.py, limit=50').

tool_output_sha256.description: SHA256 of the complete tool output text.

tool_output_artifact_path.description: Relative path to the artifact file, if output was artifacted.

observation_summary.description: What the model observed from the result, if available.

decision_after_observation.description: Decision made after seeing the result, if available.

retry_of_tool_call_id.description: If this call is a retry, the tool_call_id of the original attempt.

estimated_prompt_pressure_bytes.description: Estimated bytes this call contributed to prompt growth.
